title: Unique Paths II
description:
You are given an `m x n` integer array `grid`. There is a robot initially at the top-left corner (i.e., `grid[0][0]`). The robot wants to reach the bottom-right corner (i.e., `grid[m-1][n-1]`).

The robot can only move either down or right at any point in time. Additionally, the grid contains obstacles (represented by 1) that block certain paths.

Return the number of unique paths in the grid. Obstacles are marked with 1.
